name: Moveworks
summary: Moveworks is an AI assistant that employees reach through Slack, Microsoft Teams or the web. For HR, it answers questions from a knowledge base and works with the HR case system it connects to, such as ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, to create cases and show their status. The HR page shows no prices and offers a demo.

facts.text: The ServiceNow HR access requirements page lists a Create Case call against the HR case table, sn_hr_core_case.
The same page says the integration reads active tickets so it can show a user their ticket statuses, and lists Retrieve Ticket Status.
The HR solutions page says Moveworks' AI Assistant can help answer HR questions using the customer's knowledge base and other resources.
The HR solutions page shows Get a demo and Contact us links and no prices.

plans.name: Moveworks AI Assistant
plans.notes: Get a demo and Contact us links only. The HR solutions page shows no prices.

hiddenCosts: The HR case features on the access requirements page depend on a connected ticketing system, such as ServiceNow. The page we read does not price that system.
